method_note: A task is counted answerable only when every listed evidence fragment appears in a selected chunk from the named answer file. Import statements in the source file are not counted. This measures availability of answer-bearing implementation lines in the exported context; it does not claim a particular LLM will answer correctly.

tasks.question: When ContentEditable receives a placeholder, what accessibility prop is required, and how is the placeholder rendered?
tasks.expected_answer: An aria-placeholder string is required; a non-null placeholder renders the internal Placeholder component with the editor and content.

tasks.question: What are the two elements of LexicalComposerContextWithEditor, and how does getTheme fall back?
tasks.expected_answer: The tuple is [LexicalEditor, LexicalComposerContextType]; getTheme returns EditorThemeClasses or null/undefined and falls back to the parent context getTheme result, otherwise null.

tasks.question: What extension name does ReactProviderExtension declare, and why is it a separate extension?
tasks.expected_answer: It declares @lexical/react/ReactProvider and is separate so it can be used as a peer dependency.
evidence_fragments: It is a separate extension so it can be used as a peer dependency.

tasks.question: What does invariant do when its condition is false, including how message placeholders are handled?
tasks.expected_answer: It throws an Error after replacing successive %s placeholders with the supplied string arguments.

tasks.question: Does defineExtension transform the extension object it receives?
tasks.expected_answer: No. It is an inference helper and returns the unmodified extension argument.
evidence_fragments: @returns The unmodified extension argument (this is only an inference helper)

tasks.question: When does shallowMergeConfig return the original config object, and when does it allocate a merged object?
tasks.expected_answer: It returns the original config when overrides are absent/identical or no value differs; on the first differing override value it returns a shallow spread of config and overrides.

tasks.question: How does LexicalErrorBoundary coerce a non-Error thrown value, and what is its default fallback text?
tasks.expected_answer: It wraps non-Error values in an Error with the original value as cause; the default fallback says An error was thrown.
evidence_fragments: error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error), {cause: error})
